snippet.title: Ornament Tower | Reveal Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Ornament Tower
After getting transformed by a curse for approaching the Ornament Tower, Azulin and Guaraná decide to climb it together in order to recover their original bodies. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and reach out to each other's heart in this Action-Puzzle adventure.
